evidence: Lemma 4.1 is formalized twice over, as genuine derivatives: hasDerivAt_pullback_time/_z (and the partialT/partialZ restatements) give ∂_t(q^b f) = q^{b-1}T_b f and ∂_z(q^b f) = q^{b-D}Z_b f for arbitrary real b, with T_b and Z_b defined by timeCoeff/axialCoeff in exactly the paper's form, over the paper's L = 1-2hη². The underlying q, η, X are the manuscript's coordinates, not postulates: coordinateQ is the implicit root, tau_coordinate_identity and scalarSlope_eq_L tie it to τ = q(1-η²) and to L. The one difference is a weakening of the hypothesis from smooth f to differentiability at the point, which strengthens the Lean statement. Nothing to report.
